title: Well-being policy evaluation methodology based on WE pluralism
findings: The paper does not contain findings related to religion. It briefly mentions that the philosophical concept of 'self as WE' is an East Asian view connected to the lineage of Lao Zhuang (Taoism) and Zen thought (Buddhism) as a background for its theoretical framework.
